hypothesis: A dense whole-register nonlinear map can learn global categorical conjunctions without token/channel factorization and can transfer them across unseen N values.
correction_history: No source correction was required after independent review. The package passed all frozen topology, legality, parser, alignment, gradient, purity, max-T, and resource gates before submission.
conclusion: The whole-register MLP trained quickly and reached 12/1200 test and 6/600 aggregate OOD exact, but it produced 0/512 seen-N T1 and 2/512 OOD-N T1. The strict joint gate failed.
limitation: One Easy E5 seed and one exact 219272-state contract. Low train CE with high transfer CE indicates overfitting, but does not close all global nonlinear maps.
no_retry_history: Do not retry width, hidden size, activation, learning rate, batch, or seed. Advance only with a materially different mechanism.
